item.title: China Humanoid Robots in 2026: Production Boom Meets Deployment Reality Check as AgiBot and Unitree Lead
item.description: MIIT projects 2026 humanoid robot output to exceed 100,000 units, with AgiBot and Unitree forming a duopoly at 15,000 and 11,000 units respectively. Yet UBTechs slippage on shipments and Unitrees 70-percent research-and-education revenue share expose the gap between production and real deployment.

item.title: China Completes First Pediatric Dual Artificial Heart Surgery, Validating Aerospace-Derived Magnetic Levitation Technology
item.description: A pediatric patient at Tianjin Taida International Cardiovascular Hospital received the worlds lightest dual fully-implantable artificial hearts, custom-engineered from Aerospace Taixin magnetically levitated pumps. Five Chinese firms now hold six approved products in the VAD market.

item.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8 Foundation Model and Qianwen Office Agent, Reseating Itself in the Enterprise AI Race
item.description: Alibaba unveiled the Qwen3.8 flagship with 2.4T total parameters and 95B activation, alongside Qianwen Office for enterprise AI workflows. The base-model-plus-office strategy leverages DingTalk enterprise moat against Tencent WorkBuddy and ByteDance Doubao.

item.title: Glass Substrate Packaging Edges Toward Mass Production as Intel and Lens Technology Strike Strategic Alliance
item.description: Intel and Lens Technology signed a strategic alliance to accelerate glass substrate packaging, as Triassic and Tongge Micro push past the brittleness barrier. TGV yield, multi-layer RDL interconnect, and scale cost control now define the next phase.

item.title: China's Dexterous Hand New Top 4: From Demo to Mass Production, the First Tier Solidifies
item.description: Yinshi Robotics, Lingxin, LinJieDian and BrainCo form the new top tier as Chinas dexterous hand industry crosses the demo-to-mass-production threshold, with H1 2026 funding surpassing 25 billion yuan and shipment forecasts reaching 70,200 units.
